text:
Clara (CS): Quick flag  Stride Energy spiked overnight and our QBR forecast increased ~37%. Need rapid mitigation + a clean slide.
Ben (FinOps): Aware. Which endpoints? embeddings, chat, or batch tasks?
Rajat (Onboarding): Bulk transcript ingest + an automated nightly re-embed job. They also bumped model to `embed-high` in their config accidentally.
Lena (Solutions): Confirmed. Their deploy set `dim=1024` and retries were aggressive. That explains the burst.
CostBot: :warning: Project STR-88 at 79% monthly credits.
Ben (FinOps): Back-of-envelope additional monthly spend if unmitigated ~ $9.7k. Fast mitigations: 1) pause re-embed job, 2) flip to quantized 512-dim model, 3) enable prefix cache + dedupe, 4) apply soft quota. Which is fastest?
Rajat (Onboarding): Pause is immediate. Model flip is a one-line config change. Caching can be enabled at proxy quickly. Quota via console is trivial.
Clara (CS): I'll message the customer that we paused the job and schedule a 30m ops call. Need slide: impact, short-term actions, and ask options (credits buffer vs 10-day Dedicated trial).
Lena (Solutions): Technical runbook snippet for engineers (paste to Ops):
```bash
# pause job
POST /v1/projects/STR-88/jobs/reembed/pause

# flip embedding model
PATCH /v1/projects/STR-88/config
{ "embedding_model": "embed-512-quant", "embedding_dim": 512 }

# set soft quota
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/STR-88/quota" -d '{"soft_limit_pct":60, "hard_limit_pct":90}'
```
Ben (FinOps): Estimated mitigation impact numbers: model flip -> ~60% compute reduction; caching + dedupe -> additional ~15%; throttling -> extra ~8-10%. Combined ~75% reduction possible.
Clara (CS): For the QBR ask I prefer primary = 10-day Dedicated micro trial to show stable throughput; fallback = 15% one-off credits buffer tied to adoption milestones. Thoughts?
Ben (FinOps): Dedicated trial preferred from a renewal perspective. Credits buffer is quicker but doesn't fix predictability. I'll include both options on the slide with unit economics.
Rajat (Onboarding): Paused re-embed job at 09:11 PT. Requeues held and retries disabled.
CostBot: :white_check_mark: Incident STR-cost-spike created and assigned to #customer-success.
Lena (Solutions): Adding a tiny appendix suggestion: include per-route token rates, percent repeated docs, and avg seq len to show where savings come from.
Clara (CS): Good call. Also capture renewal risk: mark as medium-high and propose action plan in QBR. We should offer a quick ops walkthrough pre-QBR.
Ben (FinOps): I'll draft the slide and include the estimated numbers + ask options. ETA 90 minutes.
Rajat (Onboarding): I'll stand by to flip models back if they need performance for a short test.
Clara (CS): I'll draft the customer note: apology, paused job, ops call invite, and two mitigation options. Sharing in 20m for review.
Lena (Solutions): Quick dev snippet to add to the customer note for immediate throttling (pseudo):
```
batcher.set_max_concurrency(6)
batcher.set_rate_limit(100/s)
proxy.enable_cache(prefix_key=true, ttl=48h)
```
Ben (FinOps): Also recommend we propose a milestone-based credit buffer if they decline the Dedicated trial: tie credits to dedupe adoption + chunk-caching enabled.
Clara (CS): Action items: Ben finalize slide (ETA 90m), Lena add appendix & runbook, Rajat confirm no further imports until sign-off, Clara send customer note and schedule ops call.
Rajat (Onboarding): Confirmed  no imports until we sign off.
Clara (CS): Thanks team. We'll present mitigation + Dedicated trial ask in the QBR and use credits as a fallback tied to technical milestones. Update thread after slide upload. :thumbsup:
